supersedes.reason: The Phase 2 feature artifact was correctness-revised before any outcome join: exact DATE lineage, equal-weight industry dispersion, and explicit causal corporate-action coordinate coverage were fixed. EXP-P3-001 was never executed and its bound input hash is stale.

objective: Test H-003 through H-007 with continuous and fixed-quantile univariate attribution, then actively falsify temporal stability without selecting a trading threshold or interaction.
evidence_grade: EXPLORATORY_MECHANISM_EVIDENCE; all 2018-2025 outcomes were already consumed

join.causal_gate: feature first_applicable_trade_date must be no later than entry_execution_date and strictly later than entry_signal_date

outcomes.continuation_missingness: A horizon is observed only when the frozen holding path reaches it; no post-exit data or zero fill

H-007_volatility.interpretation: No monotone sign is preregistered. Fixed quintile shape is diagnostic only; an interaction is not tested here.

all_feature_policy: Report every numeric Phase 2 feature for completeness, but promotion decisions use only the preregistered primary features above.

estimators.continuous: Spearman rho with two-sided asymptotic p-value
estimators.binary: Spearman rho and Cliff's delta (positive group minus negative group)
estimators.bins: pooled feature quintiles from feature values only, qcut with duplicate edges dropped; report count, feature median, all outcome means/medians and event rates
estimators.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg q-values across all feature x primary-outcome Spearman tests; q<=0.10 is descriptive, not sufficient for promotion

falsification.within_year_rank: replace feature by its entry-year percentile rank and recompute pooled associations
falsification.leave_one_year_out: omit each entry-signal year 2018 through 2025 without refitting or changing the feature
falsification.global_ex_best5: remove the five cycles with greatest realized P&L and recompute continuous realized-return association
falsification.gate_conditioning: all actual V1 entries are already conditioned on the frozen binary market entry gate; verify index_close_to_ma20 is positive on every joined entry rather than comparing to non-entries
falsification.direction_stability: full and within-year-rank signs agree, and at least 7 of 8 LOYO estimates have the same nonzero sign as full sample
falsification.minimum_effect: absolute full-sample Spearman rho >= 0.10 for winner_ge20 or MFE
falsification.family_support: at least two primary features meet expected direction (when preregistered), direction stability, minimum effect, and no opposite-sign winner_ge50 result of absolute rho >=0.10
falsification.family_rejection: no primary feature survives, or surviving signs contradict the proposed economic mechanism

forbidden: threshold selection or strategy rule design
